release_notes: Build 161 fixes Quiz Release Automation by keeping the Native quiz card build on the desktop WPF dispatcher instead of Task.Run.
Build 161 includes a regression test that prevents the quiz card build from being moved back to a worker thread.
Build 161 restores the complete quiz card renderer after the previous release-build regression.
Build 161 keeps quiz thumbnail rendering on the desktop UI dispatcher while leaving FFmpeg and file work off-thread.
Build 159 corrected the desktop build number shown in the application to match the released build metadata.
Build 157 configuration backup recovery and Build 156 database credential recovery remain intact.
